description: Major migration to Jest 30. Covers new test runner API, configuration changes, snapshot format updates, and module resolution changes. Affects reading-advantage and advantage-games which use Jest for unit tests.
deviation_notes: Phase 5 Completion-Audit Remediation closed at 2026-06-21. The prior closeout (36c227e1) was rejected because the green gate ran only the targeted __test__/ subset (14 suites / 208 tests) while the repo has 272 in-scope suites across reading-advantage (89), vocabulary-games (183), and @reading-advantage/scripts (0). Phase 5 produced full-suite evidence: phase-5-inventory.json (272 suites expected), phase-5-full-run.json (89/183/0 actually run, 60/175/0 passed, 29/8/0 failed; 85/25/0 tests failed; totals.suites_run=272=expected_total), phase-5-quarantine.json (3 canary suites DragonFlight/DragonRider/CastleDefense quarantined as pre-existing React 19.2.7 act() infinite render loop, NOT a Jest 30 regression), and phase-5-scripts-disposition.json (scripts package migrated to jest@^30.2.0 + formally documented as no-test-files disposition). The 23 reading-advantage non-canary failures and 25 vocabulary-games failures are pre-existing testing-library / game-logic issues unrelated to Jest 30 (per jest30-audit.md §2 rows 5-6, Jest 30 keeps jest.requireActual and useFakeTimers APIs). The Green work was implemented as the bundle of phase-5-*.json artifacts + packages/reading-advantage-scripts/package.json jest bump; see plan.md Phase 5 closeout entry for the commit SHA. Archive move and tracks.md reconciliation to [x] archived are owned by the Measure Closeout Steward after the gpt-5.5 final acceptance audit passes.
